newsitem.title: USA: Whirlpool exits appliance trade association.
newsitem.headline: Whirlpool exits appliance trade association.

text.p: Whirlpool Corp said on Tuesday it terminated its membership in the Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers because of philosophical differences.
Whirlpool officials said the organization's current positions, particularly on the issue of federal appliance energy standards, run counter to the company's.
The appliance maker said it plans to obtain the necessary services and data previously provided by the group through other sources.
Whirlpool shares were up 3/8 Tuesday at 45-7/8.
